next.reason: 1985: 'Two operands connected by a THROUGH phrase must be of the same class. The two operands thus connected constitute a single selection object.' §2023:14.9.13.3 SR4: 'The two operands in a range-expression shall be of the same class and shall not be of class boolean, message-tag, object, or pointer'. Those excluded classes have no 1985 operand. §2023:14.9.13.2 makes '[ NOT ] range-expression' a single selection-object alternative. Both are compile-time rules.
